title: The Moral Foundations Weibo Corpus
reasoning: The paper focuses on the creation and benchmarking of a Chinese corpus (MFWC) based on Moral Foundations Theory. It evaluates how well various Large Language Models (GPT-4, Llama 3, and Qwen 2) can identify and classify moral sentiments and foundations—such as Care, Fairness, and Authority—within social media discourse.
